posts.title: Anil Dash: We Are Going To Kill 'Unalive'
posts.description: Anil Dash writing on the prevalence of creators using euphemisms like “unalive” for death/suicide and “grape” for sexual assault out of fear that algorithms will demonetize them. The rituals of feeding the algorithm are so built into people’s everyday habits that they’re invisible to people who weren’t alive before today’s platforms took over. posts.title: Last.fm is now independent
posts.description: Last.fm announces that it has separated from CBS and is now an independent company. Today, Last.fm begins a new chapter as an independent company. Ownership has changed, but the product you use every day has not. Your account, your listening history, and your data remain exactly where they are. The team building Last.fm is the same.
